description: Native capped-WDL smoke. Re-run the best low-bucket SF-binpack scratch shape with Bullet WDL mixing on a quiet low-|cp| slice and a small loader buffer for quick feedback.

metadata.hypothesis: The WDL=0.75 smoke failed because the uncapped SF-binpack filter was dominated by decisive high-|cp| rows. Audit of the same loader with max_abs_cp=400 produced a quiet stream: 76.07% draws, mean score -17cp, mean abs score 119cp. Test WDL on that proven-quieter slice before abandoning WDL for this source.
metadata.init: scratch quantized Bullet init; no Berserk initialization
metadata.architecture: 1 training input bucket expanded to the 32-bucket Enyo runtime layout on export; hidden=1024, l2=16
metadata.one_variable: Keep the rejected WDL=0.75 shape but change bullet_sfbinpack_max_abs_cp from 10000 to 400 based on the SF-binpack audit; use a 64 MB SF-binpack shuffle buffer so smoke feedback starts quickly.
metadata.gate: Run checkpoint 256/512 against the 800-target external gate. Stop immediately if it is not at least competitive with the CP-only 1-bucket baseline at the same checkpoint.

validation.checkpoint_sweep: Check checkpoints 256 and 512 first; do not wait for full 1024 if 256/512 fail.
validation.promotion: No SPRT unless external gate is materially better than the CP-only 1-bucket baseline and mate-like tails are sane.
validation.next: If cap400/buf64 WDL fails, stop WDL on test79 and move to data construction instead of retuning this architecture.
